description:
This process begins with identifying an employee's development needs or career aspirations.
The manager and HR create a personal development plan, which may include training programs, mentorship, or additional responsibilities.
The employee keeps working on skill enhancement while receiving feedback and evaluation from supervisors.
Once certain milestones are reached, the employee is considered for a promotion or new role.
HR conducts a formal review of performance, and if approved, the promotion is finalized with new responsibilities and compensation adjustments.
The process ends when the employee is promoted and transitions into the new role.

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EmployeePromotion" name="Employee Development and Promotion" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Roles">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideFeedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MilestonesReached</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConsiderForPromotion</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FormalPerformanceReview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReviewApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedsIdentified" name="Development need or career aspiration identified"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" name="Create personal development plan (training, mentorship, additional responsibilities)">
      <bpmn:documentation>Performed by manager and HR.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LoopMerge" name="Merge before skill development"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ContinueSkillDevelopment" name="Continue skill enhancement"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide feedback and evaluation"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MilestonesReached" name="Milestones reached?" default="Flow_MilestonesNotReached"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConsiderForPromotion" name="Consider employee for promotion or new role"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FormalPerformanceReview" name="Conduct formal performance review"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewApproved" name="Review approved?" default="Flow_NotApproved"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FinalizePromotion" name="Finalize promotion"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AssignNewResponsibilities" name="Assign new responsibilities"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedsIdentified" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds" targetRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" targetRef="Gateway_LoopMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_LoopMerge" targetRef="Task_ContinueSkillDevelopment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ContinueSkillDevelopment" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_MilestonesReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestonesReached" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_MilestonesReached" targetRef="Task_ConsiderForPromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${milestonesReached}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestonesNotReached" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_MilestonesReached" targetRef="Gateway_LoopMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderForPromotion" targetRef="Task_FormalPerformanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_FormalPerformanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved" targetRef="Task_FinalizePromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reviewApproved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_FinalizePromotion" targetRef="Task_AssignNewResponsibilities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_AssignNewResponsibilities" targetRef="Task_AdjustCompensation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_AdjustCompensation" targetRef="Task_TransitionToNewRole"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_TransitionToNewRole" targetRef="EndEvent_Promoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
